answers.stem_only: Amazon GuardDuty enabled organization-wide through a delegated administrator in the security account; its threat intelligence produces findings for EC2 traffic to known malicious IPs.
Amazon Macie with a scheduled (daily) sensitive data discovery job, using managed data identifiers for credit card numbers, managed from a Macie administrator account.
Download the AWS SOC 2 report and PCI DSS AOC from AWS Artifact (self-service portal for AWS compliance reports) and give them to the auditor.
AWS Config configuration history (configuration items / resource timeline) for the security group at that point in time.

AWS Security Hub enabled for the organization with the security account as delegated administrator, plus cross-Region aggregation into one home Region; it ingests GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie findings in one normalized list.
Amazon Inspector activated organization-wide through a delegated administrator; it scans EC2 instances (agentless or SSM agent) for software CVEs and produces findings.

An SCP on the organization root that denies s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock (applies to member root users), plus an AWS Config managed rule for S3 server access logging with automatic remediation through an SSM Automation document.
Pivot from the GuardDuty finding into Amazon Detective and use the behavior graph / role profile to see the IP addresses and API calls of the role over time.
Enable Amazon GuardDuty; it reads CloudTrail management events, VPC flow logs and DNS logs from its own independent streams, so no trail or flow logs need to be set up first.
GuardDuty keeps findings for a fixed 90 days; configure findings export from the delegated administrator to an S3 bucket (KMS-encrypted) and apply a 2-year retention / lifecycle on that bucket.
GuardDuty Malware Protection for S3 on the upload bucket (scans new objects, tags results) and Amazon Macie sensitive data discovery for PII.
Security Hub CSPM controls depend on AWS Config recording in each Region; enable AWS Config recording in us-west-2 for every account.
